content_sections.heading: About MGU Research Associate
content_sections.text: Mahatma Gandhi University is located at Priyadarsini Hills P.O., Kottayam, Kerala - 686 560, and its letterhead states that it was established by the Kerala State Legislature by Notification No. 3431/Leg. Cl/85/Law, dated 17th April 1985. This vacancy is for engagement at the university's School of Energy Materials. The notice is Re-Notification - 3 for this post, which follows the original notification dated 27.09.2025 and Re-Notifications 1 and 2 dated 07.06.2026 and 10.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is one Research Associate vacancy. It is reserved for the EBT category. *The notice states that in the absence of applicants from the EBT category, applicants belonging to other reserved categories will be considered. In the absence of applicants from other reserved categories, applicants from the Open Competition category (OC) will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master of Science in Chemistry/Polymer Science Ph. D. in Polymer Science/Nanotechnology/Energy Materials Published Works of High Standard Post Doctoral Experience in International Laboratories For a degree obtained from universities or institutions outside the State of Keralam, the application must be accompanied by an equivalency / eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University. The age limit is a maximum of 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per norms. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate receives ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated). Engagement is on a contract basis, temporarily, for one year initially. The term is likely to be extended up to a maximum of 3 years, based on a performance evaluation report by a committee to be constituted by the Vice Chancellor of the University. The selected candidate shall enter into a contract for one year with the University.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MGU Research Associate
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only, within 15 days from the date of the notification (20 November 2026). Fill in the Interview Proforma attached to the notification (pages 3 and 4 of the PDF). Collect signed hard copies of the original documents listed below. Send the proforma and the documents by email to [email protected] . Mark the email as: "Application for the post of Research Associate on Contract in the School of Energy Materials". Send it within 15 days from 20 November 2026, that is, by about 05 December 2026. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MGU Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Research Associate vacancy at the School of Energy Materials, reserved for the EBT category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 15 days from the date of the notification, 20 November 2026, which is about 05 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the MGU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master of Science in Chemistry/Polymer Science, a Ph. D. in Polymer Science/Nanotechnology/Energy Materials and published works of high standard. Post Doctoral Experience in International Laboratories is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MGU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 50 years, and age relaxation is applicable as per norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the MGU Research Associate?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹60,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the MGU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email the filled-in proforma and signed copies of the required documents to [email protected], marked "Application for the post of Research Associate on Contract in the School of Energy Materials".

faq.question: Q7. How will the MGU Research Associate be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be interviewed; the details of the interview will be informed later, for eligible candidates only.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MGU Research Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contract engagement for one year initially, likely to be extended up to a maximum of 3 years based on a performance evaluation by a committee constituted by the Vice Chancellor.

faq.question: Q9. Can non-EBT candidates apply for the MGU Research Associate post?
faq.answer: If there are no EBT applicants, applicants from other reserved categories will be considered, and if there are none from those categories either, Open Competition (OC) applicants will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. What if my degree is from a university outside Keralam?
faq.answer: Your application must be accompanied by an equivalency / eligibility certificate from Mahatma Gandhi University.
